arabic text: AJAO CHAND MERAY TERI PYAAS MEY BHUJAO ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: O MY BELOVED, LET ME QUENCH YOUR THIRST, ASGHAR I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: MERE LADLE KAHA HO SEENAY TUMHE LAGAAON ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: OH MY DARLING, LET ME HOLD YOU CLOSE TO MY HEART, ASGHAR I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: TERAY JHOOLAY KO SAKINA, RO RO KE CHOOMTI HAIN\nTUJHE RAN MEY DHOONDTI HAIN\nTERI MAUT KI KHABAR MEY KAISAY USAY SUNAO, ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: SAKINA CRIES AND KISSES YOUR CRADLE, AND THEN SHE RUNS TO THE BATTLEFIELD AND LOOKS FOR YOU, HOW SHALL I BREAK THE NEWS OF YOUR DEATH TO HER? ASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: BETA TUMHARA QATIL, MERAY SAMNE KHARA HAIN JANAY KYUN HAS RAHA HAIN\nCHADAR BHI LUTGAYI HAIN, MU KISTARHE CHUPAO, ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: O MY SON, YOUR KILLER IS STANDING IN FRONT OF ME, I WONDER WHY HE LAUGHS, MY VEIL HAS BEEN SNATCHED AWAY, HOW SHOULD I COVER MY FACE? ASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: LAGTA HAIN MAA SE ASGHAR NARAAZ HOGEYA HAIN\nMAQTAL MEY SOGEYA HAIN\nDHOONDO KAHA MEY USKO AUR KISTARHE JAGAON ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: ASGHAR, IT SEEMS AS IF YOU ARE UPSET WITH YOUR MOTHER, YOU HAVE GONE TO SLEEP IN THE BATTLEFIELD, WHERE SHALL I LOOK FOR YOU AND HOW SHALL I WAKE YOU UP? ASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: MAIDAAN MEY JAKAY JURAT ESI TUM DIKHANA\nGHAZI HI NAZAR AANA TU PYAAS MEY HAIN PAR MEY PAANI KIDHAR SEY LAAON ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: WHEN YOU GO TO THE BATTLEFIELD, SHOW SUCH BRAVERY THAT YOU APPEAR TO BE LIKE ABBAS, YOU ARE VERY THIRSTY BUT WHERE SHALL I GET WATER FROM?\nASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: MERI JAAN JARAHI HAIN YE SOCH SOCH ASGHAR\nYE TEER KAISAY JHELA BEHNON KO KYA BATAO ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: IS PHOOL SEY GALAY PAR\nIT IS UNBEARABLE FOR ME TO THINK OF HOW YOUR DELICATE THROAT WAS PIERCED BY THAT HEAVY ARROW, WHAT SHALL I TELL YOUR SISTERS? ASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER

arabic text: AKTHAR SAGHEER PAL MEY, KHAMOSH HOGEYA THA\nPYAASA HI SOGEYA THA PHIR BHI RUBAB POOCHAY, MEY SHAAM KAISAY JAAON, ASGHAR MEY TERI MAA HOON
english translation text: IN AN INSTANT, HE BECAME QUIET, HE FELL ASLEEP THIRSTY, BUT STILL RUBAB ASKED, HOW SHALL I GO TO SHAAM? ASGHAR, I AM YOUR MOTHER
